newsitem.title: USA: MRV plans gigabit ethernet launch.
newsitem.headline: MRV plans gigabit ethernet launch.

text.p: MRV Communications Inc President Noam Lotan said Friday the company plans to unveil a network switching technology, called gigabit ethernet, at the NetWorld Interop trade show in Atlanta beginning Sept. 18.

The hightly anticipated switching technology can move data at speeds up to 1 billion bits per second and has the potential to overcome distance limitations and throughput and time delays with no additional user costs.
Lotan told Reuters that MRV, which makes local area network (LAN) switching and fiber optic transmission products, believes it is the first company to have a working prototype of the technology.

Tuesday, network equipment giant Cisco Systems said it has reached an agreement to acquire privately held Granite Systems Inc in a $220 million deal that gives them access to the same sort of Gigabit Ethernet technology.

MRV is currently shipping its MegaSwitch II product, a new auto-configuring Ethernet/Fast Ethernet switch, with planned asynchronous transfer mode and Gigabit Ethernet uplink modules expected to be commercially available in the fourth quarter of 1996.
